rationale: The Entry Motion sensor (SEN-M1) shows no LED response at all when SYNC is held for 15 seconds, even placed directly next to the base station, while all other bound devices are online and the base station is healthy (no fault codes, uplink ok). The customer reported dropping the sensor on tiles while changing the battery, and RSSI (-60 dBm) and firmware (1.4, protocol v3, compatible) are both fine, ruling out signal and firmware causes. A device that fails to respond to reset even adjacent to the base station after physical impact indicates a hardware fault requiring escalation.
